master: Use case: stylized-concept. Production master character design for Crownforge, a premium original historical-fantasy strategy game. Create a FOUR-VIEW full-body character turnaround on a genuinely transparent alpha background, one character per quadrant in a 2x2 grid, complete figures with generous empty gutters. This is the SAME adult female Crownwarden Hearthkin artisan in all four views. Upper left faces camera (slightly elevated front); upper right faces screen-right in profile; lower left faces away from camera (back); lower right faces screen-left in profile. Consistent elevated orthographic camera, 25-degree downward viewing angle, no perspective. Design: strong, warm, capable adult woman in her early thirties, realistic athletic proportions, auburn hair in one thick long practical braid, cream linen kerchief tied behind the head leaving her face open. Rich petrol-teal sleeveless working tunic with split knee-length front panels over a cream rolled-sleeve linen blouse, dark fitted work trousers, sturdy russet leather ankle boots. Well-worn dark leather utility belt, small brass crown-knot clasp, one leather bracer, stitched apron side panel, small tool pouch. Balanced practical medieval maker silhouette, not a princess or heavily armored soldier. A small handsome iron hand-axe hangs in her relaxed right hand. Materials: beautifully tactile woven cloth, seams and layered folds, soft scuffed leather, forged metal. Modern high-end 3D-rendered game character appearance with refined believable anatomy, sculpted face and physically convincing light, painterly surface finesse, exceptional sharpness, no cartoon outlines, no pixel art, no grain or gold wash. Warm soft key from upper left, cool ambient bounce. Grounded relaxed neutral stance with feet spaced naturally, head upright, quiet confident expression. Exactly the same garment details, face, body, braid and equipment in every view. No scenery, no ground discs, no drop shadows, no text, no labels, no grid, no background color or haze. REAL transparent background between every figure.

transparentExtraction:
Use case: background-extraction
Asset type: transparent PNG game sprite sheet
Primary request: Extract all separate character components or equipment props from the supplied image onto a genuinely transparent background with an alpha channel.
Input image: edit target.
Constraints: keep each component and its placement, detail, color, facing direction and size unchanged. Remove only the background. Preserve clean edges and all gaps. The output is a transparent cutout PNG, not an illustration of cutouts on paper.
